key_insight: Reinforcement learning can navigate SMEFT operator combinations to discover diverse new-physics hypotheses that improve agreement with experimental data.
engineering_relevance: A compact actor-critic agent offers a strategy for exploring large combinatorial scientific model spaces with correlated effects.
method: Formulate SMEFT operator exploration as sequential decision-making.
Use a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters.
Seek diverse, high-quality multi-operator theories rather than one best-fit theory.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covers 132 particle-physics observables, including 24 deviations above 1.5σ, and compares RL with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify search speedups or establish generalization beyond the tested phenomenological environment.
paper_title: A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
